description: Sinkholes - Dataset is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sgi.isprambiente.it. The data of the sinkings contained in the National Sinkhole Database are related to the census of the only plain areas of the national territory collected through bibliographical research and site inspections. However, these data, which are not yet final, are continuously updated and supplemented. Coverage: IT. Its keywords include open data. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
